sect1.title: Dolphin-&dolphin-version;

sect2.title: Introduksjon til Dolphin
sect2.para: Dolphin pakken (ikke å forveksle med KF6 dolphin filbehandler) tilbyr en GCN og Wii emulator.
CMake, FFmpeg, libevdev, &opengl;, og Xorg Libraries
alsa-utils, BlueZ, cURL, , fmt, , libusb, libxkbcommon, libxml2, LLVM, &logind; , , PulseAudio, Qt-6, , Speex, og Vulkan-Loader

sect2.title: Nedlasting av Dolphin
sect2.para: Lag en liste over nødvendige tarballer som skal lastes ned:

screen.userinput:
cat > dolphin-list << "EOF" dolphin-emu/dolphin/archive/&dolphin-version;/dolphin-&dolphin-version;.tar.gz SFML/SFML/archive/&dolphin-sfml-external;.tar.gz GPUOpen-LibrariesAndSDKs/VulkanMemoryAllocator/archive/&dolphin-vk-mem-alloc-external;.tar.gz mozilla/cubeb/archive/&dolphin-cubeb-external;.tar.gz arsenm/sanitizers-cmake/archive/&dolphin-sanitize-external;.tar.gz libusb/hidapi/archive/&dolphin-hidapi-external;.tar.gz epezent/implot/archive/&dolphin-implot-external;.tar.gz mgba-emu/mgba/archive/&dolphin-mgba-external;.tar.gz miniupnp/miniupnp/archive/&dolphin-miniupnp-external;.tar.gz zlib-ng/minizip-ng/archive/&dolphin-minizip-ng-external;.tar.gz RetroAchievements/rcheevos/archive/&dolphin-rcheevos-external;.tar.gz KhronosGroup/SPIRV-Cross/archive/&dolphin-spirv-cross-external;.tar.gz syoyo/tinygltf/archive/&dolphin-tinygltf-external;.tar.gz e-dant/watcher/archive/&dolphin-watcher-external;.tar.gz Cyan4973/xxHash/archive/&dolphin-xxhash-external;.tar.gz zlib-ng/zlib-ng/archive/&dolphin-zlib-ng-external;.tar.gz
# Required if you have not installed some recommended dependencies lsalzman/enet/archive/&dolphin-enet-external;.tar.gz fmtlib/fmt/archive/&dolphin-fmt-external;.tar.gz randy408/libspng/archive/&dolphin-libspng-external;.tar.gz libusb/libusb/archive/&dolphin-libusb-external;.tar.gz EOF

sect2.para: Last nå ned pakken, undermodulene og nødvendige oppdateringer hvis aktuelt, ved hjelp av Wget:

screen.userinput: mkdir dolphin-emu && cd dolphin-emu && grep -v '^#' ../dolphin-list | wget -i- -c \ -B &dolphin-dl-root;

sect2.title: Installasjon av Dolphin

screen.userinput: for i in *.tar.?z*; do echo "Extracting $i..." tar -xf $i done

sect2.para: Nå som alt er pakket ut, må de nødvendige utpakkede undermodulene flyttes inn i dolphin-&dolphin-version;. Gjør det ved å kjøre følgende kommandoer:

screen.userinput: mv -T SFML-* dolphin-&dolphin-version;/Externals/SFML/SFML && mv -T VulkanMemoryAllocator-* \ dolphin-&dolphin-version;/Externals/VulkanMemoryAllocator && mv -T cubeb-* dolphin-&dolphin-version;/Externals/cubeb/cubeb && mv -T sanitizers-cmake-* \ dolphin-&dolphin-version;/Externals/cubeb/cubeb/cmake/sanitizers-cmake && mv -T hidapi-* dolphin-&dolphin-version;/Externals/hidapi/hidapi-src && mv -T implot-* dolphin-&dolphin-version;/Externals/implot/implot && mv -T mgba-* dolphin-&dolphin-version;/Externals/mGBA/mgba && mv -T miniupnp-* dolphin-&dolphin-version;/Externals/miniupnpc/miniupnp && mv -T minizip-ng-* dolphin-&dolphin-version;/Externals/minizip-ng/minizip-ng && mv -T rcheevos-* dolphin-&dolphin-version;/Externals/rcheevos/rcheevos && mv -T SPIRV-Cross-* dolphin-&dolphin-version;/Externals/spirv_cross/SPIRV-Cross && mv -T tinygltf-* dolphin-&dolphin-version;/Externals/tinygltf/tinygltf && mv -T watcher-* dolphin-&dolphin-version;/Externals/watcher/watcher && mv -T xxHash-* dolphin-&dolphin-version;/Externals/xxhash/xxHash && mv -T zlib-ng-* dolphin-&dolphin-version;/Externals/zlib-ng/zlib-ng

Gå nå inn i dolphin-&dolphin-version; mappen:
Fjern et upassende suffiks som forhindrer bygging for nettspill støtte:
Installer Dolphin ved å kjøre følgende kommandoer:

screen.userinput:
mkdir build && cd build &&
cmake -D CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=/usr \ -D CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \ -D CMAKE_SKIP_INSTALL_RPATH=ON \ -D CMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM=3.5 \ -D ENABLE_TESTS=OFF \ -D USE_SYSTEM_LIBMGBA=OFF \ -G Ninja -W no-dev .. &&
ninja
